therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Regulatory T cell depletion to enhance vaccine-induced immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced tumor-specific T cell activation and proliferation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Clinical response rate (PR + SD + PD proportion)

results.effect_size: No clinical responses observed in combination arm vs vaccine alone
safety_signals: Serious adverse events included syncope, chest pain, abdominal pain, and pericardial tamponade

dose_info.schedule: vaccine every 2 weeks, Ontak single dose 4 days before first vaccine

context.investigator_commentary: The immune monitoring data failed to demonstrate an improvement in any biologic endpoint with denileukin diftitox.

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Denileukin diftitox depletes CD25+ regulatory T cells to enhance vaccine-induced anti-tumor immune responses
modulation_entries.citation: The immune monitoring data failed to demonstrate an improvement in any biologic endpoint with denileukin diftitox.
